legalMoves.description: Create your character: name, race (human/kralkin/hexapod/grull), ship name, and ability scores — recommended method: one score 3, one 2, one 1 (e.g. { SWA: 3, HAK: 2, SNE: 1 }); or distribute 6 points (max 3 per ability). Optional disposition: brash or risk averse (a roleplay hint only). FILL IN the values the player chose — do not submit this skeleton.

OR pick an archetype card — a pre-built spread with a printed difficulty: Void Runner (Easy ★) — SNE +3 / MEC +2 / RES +1: slip past everything and keep the ship whole — tends to win Conquest · Ghost Smuggler (Easy ★) — SNE +3 / HAK +2 / SWA +1: stealth backed by system intrusion — tends to win Conquest · Privateer (Moderate ★★) — PIL +3 / SWA +2 / MEC +1: a fighting captain who boards what she cannot outrun — tends to win Bounty · Fleet Captain (Moderate ★★) — LEA +3 / MEC +2 / RES +1: inspirational command and a growing crew — tends to win Legend · Ace Pilot (Hard ★★★) — PIL +3 / MEC +2 / RES +1: pure flying skill in long campaigns — tends to win Legend or Conquest · Netdiver (Hard ★★★) — HAK +3 / MEC +2 / RES +1: hacks credits straight out of pirate hulls — tends to win Fortune · Field Scholar (Brutal ★★★★) — RES +3 / GUN +2 / PIL +1: a scholar-XP engine that shoots back — tends to win Legend · Grease Monkey (Brutal ★★★★) — MEC +3 / PIL +2 / RES +1: an engineer who redlines the engines mid-fight — tends to win Legend · Dread Corsair (Brutal ★★★★) — DEM +3 / PIL +2 / DIP +1: terror, tribute, and a name pirates whisper — tends to win Bounty. FILL IN name/race/ship and the chosen card's printed name as archetype name.
